title: Spanish agents stay idle
summary: A Classics-style menu offers Spanish, then REQAGENT never widens the proficiency window. Agents with proficiency 6 through 12 sit available.
log:
script=main action=REQAGENT high=1 low=5
skill=Spanish agents_available=4 proficiency=6,8,9,12
queue_age_min=6 updatecontact=absent
note=synthetic

steps.ask: Which action is missing from the trace?

choices: Only proficiencies from 1 through 5 are eligible

fix: Add the UpdateContact the bullseye example uses, and confirm the agents' proficiencies. The log is synthetic.

title: Outbound dialing is starving inbound
summary: A Personal Connection skill still has acceleration 1, so its priority climbs like an inbound queue. Inbound skills wait.
log:
skill=PC-Sales acceleration=1 initial=4 age_min=3 overall=7
inbound=Support acceleration=1 initial=1 age_min=1 overall=2
note=synthetic

steps.ask: What should Personal Connection do with acceleration?
Overall priority for initial 4, acceleration 1, at 3 minutes?
Where else is PC proficiency dialing enabled?

fix: Set PC acceleration to 0 and confirm both enablement places. Do not invent pacing weights.

title: A new digital routing queue
summary: Someone is trying to create a routing queue for a new inbound chat. The product change in Summer 2023 moved new inbound digital work to skills and scripts.
log:
channel=chat created=2026-10-01 attempt=new routing queue
error=cannot create new routing queues
old_queue=Billing-Legacy sync=skill
note=synthetic

steps.ask: Can you create a new routing queue?

choices: Routing queues, with WFA assigning the skill

fix: Create a digital skill and script. Leave the old queue in place if it is already synced. Precedence when both WFA and Studio set a skill is not settled in this lab.

title: The recording looks cut off
summary: QA hears silence where the caller was on hold, including no hold music. A consultation in the same minute is present.
log:
contact=synthetic-1044 hold_start=00:02:10 hold_end=00:02:28
audio_during_hold=none consult_during_hold=present peer=synthetic-agent-b
note=synthetic

choices: When the agent returns to the caller

fix: Close it as the documented hold gap unless a different symptom remains after the agent returns.

title: The connector starts returning 401
summary: An administrator disabled the access key used by a connector. Tokens died immediately. The secret cannot be displayed again.
log:
employee=connector-ucce key_status=disabled
result=401 on the next call secret_visible=no
note=synthetic

steps.ask: What does disabling a key do to its tokens?
The secret was not saved. Now what?
Who should own the new key?
choices: The dedicated connector employee, not a full admin

fix: Mint a new key as the connector employee, store the secret, and update the connector. The 401 matches the keys page.

title: UCCE historical rows are empty
summary: Real-time adherence moves. Fifteen-minute skill history does not. Web Setup was left on a role other than AW-HDS-DDS.
log:
connector=cisco-ucce rta=updating
historical_skills=0 interval=15m
web_setup_role=not-AW-HDS-DDS
note=synthetic

steps.ask: Historical skills on this connector use?
choices: SQL on the Cisco ACD database
The place those rows should appear

fix: Set the Administration and Data Server role to AW-HDS-DDS and recheck PG Explorer. Do not look for this feed in Intraday.

title: Every Salesforce record opens a new browser tab
summary: Lightning is on. Navigation is still standard. Agents get a new browser tab for each interaction.
log:
salesforce=Lightning navigation=standard
symptom=new browser tab per interaction
agent_integrations=on
note=synthetic

steps.ask: Which navigation does the page require?

choices: Opens a new browser tab per interaction
Groups tabs on one Salesforce screen

fix: Switch the org to console navigation. Lightning alone is not the whole prerequisite.

title: The CRM case has no summary
summary: The agent saw an AutoSummary in the Notes field. The Salesforce case did not. There is no Contact mapping for Disposition Notes.
log:
app=Agent Workspace summary_local=yes
crm=Salesforce case_notes=empty
mapping=Contact/Disposition Notes absent
note=synthetic

steps.ask: Without a CRM integration, other agents…
choices: Do not see the generated summary

fix: Add the Contact / Disposition Notes data mapping. Confirm the channel is voice or digital messaging, not email.
